suite: Pricing Model V2 — DB-backed economic gate

economic_invariants.proves: a payment credits the wallet GROSS even with a matching 5% rule present — capture consults nobody
no operator_fees row is written — not a row with a fee of zero
a single balanced two-leg posting; a fee would have added a paired one
an explicit 0-bps SETTLEMENT rule settles at zero, attributably
the ABSENCE of a rule refuses and moves nothing
ambiguity is a configuration error, never settled by comparing UUIDs
a nonzero rate produces the correct fee, balanced
a later rule change never reprices a completed settlement
the payout bank leg carries the NET; the fee is its own paired posting
a completed payout explains its own price — rule, version, rate, fee, net, decided_at

note: This gate certifies the CODE. It does not certify the deployed Sandbox: migrations 0109-0111 are not applied there, and must be applied through the operator-TTY path (docs/runbooks/pricing-v2-migration.md) before the V2 code is deployed. The deployed Sandbox remains on the transitional baseline 858d80d8, which is correct until then.
not_proved_here: deployed behaviour — the economic smoke (tests/phase0/economic-model-smoke.sh) has not run against a V2 Sandbox
ordinary-vs-reference parity on the deployed runtime
